# SMM Panel

> Social Media Marketing Services and Live Order Tracking.

## Overview
SMM Panel is a reliable platform for ordering social media growth services with transparent INR pricing, live order tracking, and automatic wallet refunds for cancelled or partial orders.

## Core Features
- **INR Wallet:** Top up balance using UPI, cards, and netbanking.
- **Automated Order Dispatch:** Fast order synchronization with transparent start times and quantity limits.
- **Live Order Tracking:** Real-time status updates from placement through completion.
- **Automatic Wallet Refunds:** Unfulfilled portions on cancelled or partial orders automatically return to your wallet balance.

## Supported Social Platforms
- **Instagram:** Followers, Likes, Reels Views, Comments
- **YouTube:** Views, Subscribers, Likes
- **TikTok:** Views, Followers, Likes
- **Telegram:** Channel Members, Post Views, Reactions
- **X:** Followers, Reposts, Likes

## Support
- Contact: support@smmpanel.com
